correctness.rationale: Rechecked the proof in repairs/2/RESULT.md. Independent edge coordinates force the center to be exactly Z and give commuting quotient vectors V_i for single-part support and F_q x for mixed support, by equality of pure tensors. Mixed supports exist, so the least component after removing the c universal vertices has order b=c(q−1). Neither q nor N needs to be provided: q=1+b/c and the total graph order is cq^N. Larger components give the nonsingleton sizes with multiplicity; subtract their sum from N to count singletons, including the all-singleton case. The frozen forward formulas, ranks and probability are correct but are not retained as standalone contributions. A bounded direct bracket check in F_3[t]/(t²+1), for parts (2,1), enumerated quotient vector pairs using the two edge determinants: one nonzero component of order 80 and 81 of order 8, all cliques. Over the center of order 81 this gives 59049 vertices, recovered q=9 and parts (2,1); it also gave rank polynomial 81+6480z+52488z² and commuting probability 161/6561. The repaired proof, not this single replay case, covers all stated orders. Frozen scripts were read, not executed.
